svg.title: The Odds Data-Pipe Freshness Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-odds-data-pipe-freshness-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: The Odds Data-Pipe Freshness Funnel; subtitle: Rejecting stale feeds down to a 5-second refresh and a priced cross-book gap; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Reject 5-minute delayed feeds; value: 300; display: 300 seconds of delay; conversion: Baseline to reject; detail: OddsJam dismisses five-minute delayed feeds as useless when lines move on injury news.; label: Demand a 99.9 uptime floor; value: 99.9; display: 99.9 uptime; conversion: Feed qualifies on availability; detail: OddsJam cites 99.9 uptime alongside sportsbook and market coverage when pitching the API.; label: Cache responses for 30 seconds; value: 30; display: 30-second cache and refresh; conversion: Dashboard refresh matches the cache; detail: SportsGameOdds caches the events response for 30 seconds; trim oddIDs, pass a bookmakerID, keep the key in .env.local on the server and send it in the X-API-Key header.; label: Surface the cross-book gap; value: 12.5; display: 12.5% spread between -167 and +300; conversion: Gap becomes a locked edge; detail: Brandon of DingerStats flags a Rangers-Angels game where two books priced sides 12.5% apart.; label: Act on a 5-second refresh; value: 5; display: 5-second refresh on most markets; conversion: Price acted on while still live; detail: OddsJam pushes five-second refresh on most markets so the gap is still there when the bet goes in.; caption: Odds operators agree latency and coverage decide value: reject delayed feeds, cache deliberately, and only act on gaps priced from fresh lines.; assumptions note: Stage values carry their reported units (seconds, uptime, percent spread) and are ordered as a pipeline, not as a measured conversion ratio between stages.; note: Attributed to OddsJam (Sports Betting Strategy & Education, ZTKIge6SyQI and Gjuo-nBvRiM) and SportsGameOdds API (JXdlRbDVFNY, auctQZC3iOE).

circle.title: label: Reject 5-minute delayed feeds; value: 300; display: 300 seconds of delay; conversion: Baseline to reject; detail: OddsJam dismisses five-minute delayed feeds as useless when lines move on injury news.

label: Demand a 99.9 uptime floor; value: 99.9; display: 99.9 uptime; conversion: Feed qualifies on availability; detail: OddsJam cites 99.9 uptime alongside sportsbook and market coverage when pitching the API.

label: Cache responses for 30 seconds; value: 30; display: 30-second cache and refresh; conversion: Dashboard refresh matches the cache; detail: SportsGameOdds caches the events response for 30 seconds; trim oddIDs, pass a bookmakerID, keep the key in .env.local on the server and send it in the X-API-Key header.

label: Surface the cross-book gap; value: 12.5; display: 12.5% spread between -167 and +300; conversion: Gap becomes a locked edge; detail: Brandon of DingerStats flags a Rangers-Angels game where two books priced sides 12.5% apart.

label: Act on a 5-second refresh; value: 5; display: 5-second refresh on most markets; conversion: Price acted on while still live; detail: OddsJam pushes five-second refresh on most markets so the gap is still there when the bet goes in.

text.title: Assumptions: Stage values carry their reported units (seconds, uptime, percent spread) and are ordered as a pipeline, not as a measured conversion ratio between stages.
